slope_max_deg.label: Steepest 1 m slope
slope_max_deg.source: DTM slope (Horn), max of 4x4 1 m pixels
slope_max_deg.note: DTM slope, max of the 4x4 1 m pixels in the cell

rough_max_m.label: Roughness (5 m plane-fit residual)
rough_max_m.source: DTM 5 m plane-fit residual std, max of 4x4
rough_max_m.note: NaN where the roughness window was invalid

loose.label: Loose ground index
loose.source: THEMIS dawn brightness temperature, median of 12 images (-z/2, clipped)
loose.note: THEMIS dawn temperature, about 100 m pixels

rock_frac.label: Rock area fraction
rock_frac.source: HiRISE 25 cm ortho shadow detection (rocks_detect.py), mean of 4x4

ground_type.label: Ground type
ground_type.source: rule from slope, roughness, ortho texture (demo/twin/material_4m.json, corridor 252x325 cells)

shielding_factor.label: Shielding factor (dose relative to Curiosity's track)
shielding_factor.source: sky_view / mean sky_view on Curiosity's track cells
shielding_factor.note: sky_view / mean sky_view on Curiosity's track cells

dtm_uncert_m.label: DTM uncertainty
dtm_uncert_m.source: |DTM A - DTM B aligned - median offset (-7.35 m)|, mean of 4x4; includes real change + residual co-registration error

dist_to_rover_track_m.label: Distance to Curiosity's track
dist_to_rover_track_m.source: Curiosity registered traverse (all sols, segments in the ROI)

valid_frac.label: Valid terrain fraction
valid_frac.source: share of valid 1 m terrain+roughness pixels
